description: Plays a recorded crash cymbal, one press of the button picking which of eight vintage drum machines it is taken from

params.text: Each press steps to the next of the eight machines printed on the panel, the press after DMX returning to 808, and the lamp beside the machine in use is lit

inputs.text: A rising edge restarts the sample from its beginning; it fires when the voltage reaches 1V and cannot fire again until the voltage has returned to 0V

outputs.text: The chosen sample played once through, falling to 0V once it has reached its end

notes: the sample advances one frame per engine sample with no rate conversion, so the engine sample rate sets its pitch and its length
no sound comes out until a trigger arrives at TRIG IN; pressing the panel button only changes which machine's sample is selected, it does not play it
